icons.name: agent-skills
icons.heading: Agent skills
icons.description: A skill cartridge is loaded into its dock. Light: the cartridge drops into the dock and lands with a hit; the dock takes the load, giving under it with the cartridge, and both spring back and settle with the cartridge seated. Strong: the cartridge is lifted first, then driven down harder; the dock gives further and the pair settle in two beats. Eject: the cartridge is pulled up, dragging the dock a little, then pops free; the dock snaps back with a rebound and the cartridge settles above it. Cartridge and dock stay rigid.

icons.name: mcp-tools
icons.heading: MCP tools
icons.description: A tool is connected over MCP: the two-prong plug seats into its tool port. Light: the plug drives in and its prongs meet the port with a hit; the housing is knocked back by the contact, carrying the plug with it, and both spring back and settle with the plug seated. Strong: the plug is pulled back first, then driven in harder; the housing is knocked further and the pair settle in two beats. Disconnect: the plug is pulled back, dragging the housing a little, then comes free; the housing snaps back with a rebound and the plug settles, fully opaque. Plug and housing stay rigid.

icons.name: background-run
icons.heading: Background run
icons.description: The task is sent to the background and keeps running there. Light: the front pane steps aside down-left, overshoots a little and settles, and a beat later the progress knob in the back pane runs the length of its track and stops at the end. Strong: the front pane is nudged back first, then pushed further aside and settles in two beats; the knob runs faster and pops as it reaches the end. The back pane's edges stay cut exactly where the front pane covers them. The reset slides the panes back opaque and fades the knob back to its start, as in v1.
